# Experimental features

Features that ship for the GM to try are off until switched on in the command palette's Experimental features page (`command-palette/ExperimentalFeaturesPanel.tsx`: one switch per entry of `EXPERIMENTAL_FEATURES`, `src/app/experimental/experimentalFeatures.ts`). The choice is global, stored in Atlas' settings under the feature's id (`AtlasSettings.experimental`; never rename an id) and read only through `SettingsService.isExperimentalOn`: `experimentalFeatureOn(app, id)` outside React, `useExperimentalFeature(id)` in React, which follows the switch at once. A vault whose settings cannot be reached reads as off. Tests switch a feature on with `withStatblockEditor(app)` or `withOnlinePlay(app)` (`tests/mocks/experimentalFeatures.ts`). `featureFlags.ts` stays for what a build must not offer at all.
